network: Three separate Helia nodes over localhost TCP/Noise/Yamux with private Kademlia protocol; no public bootstrap or HTTP block brokers
ipns: Real signed IPNS records published and resolved through local libp2p DHT, not a pointer map simulation

checks.name: Separate aggregator resolves two registered real IPNS names and fetches signed feeds over Bitswap
Aggregator deduplicates metadata, reuses existing ranking, and does not fetch article bodies
Independent reader resolves aggregator IPNS and fetches signed immutable popularity snapshot
Client final full-body filtering excludes short article, beyond aggregator metadata ranking
Duplicate listing and rating IDs collapse
Signed but frozen old feed rejected by freshness
Valid older feed sequence rejected after observing newer one
Oversized feed rejected before parsing events
Malformed oversized article and future vote rejected
Stable contributor IPNS name updates to a newer signed feed
Optional HTTP client polls separate aggregator snapshot and health without article hosting

unverified: Public DHT long-term durability (short-lived pointer discovery tested separately)
Browser extension transport and sleep lifecycle
Automatically discovering previously unknown feed names
